high_level_description: The image shows two women standing side by side against a plain, light-colored wall. The woman on the left has short, platinum blonde hair styled in an updo. She is wearing black sunglasses with a sleek frame, a black top, and large, dark earrings. Her expression is serious and composed. The woman on the right has long, wavy brown hair and is wearing black sunglasses as well. She is dressed in a sleeveless black dress with vertical pinstripes and accessorized with a pearl necklace and a gold pendant. She is smiling warmly, giving off a friendly and approachable vibe.
